title: textEDA IR v0.1 — schematic shard
description: Schematic IR of one board: the flattened result of the board root plus all pages. There is only one instances / nets list — flattening is the single representation; pages keep only the page instantiation relations. See ADR-0007, ADR-0008 decision 2.

format.description: Language version of the .teda file that produced this shard.

source.description: Source-file location: path relative to the project root plus an optional line number.

board.description: The board_id shared with sch/<board_id>.teda and pcb/<board_id>.teda.

pages.description: Page instantiation relations, not a netlist. Omitted when the board has no pages.

instances.description: All component instances on the board, the flattened unique list.

nets.description: All nets, the flattened unique list.

ports.description: Board-level ports, connecting to external interfaces.

buses.description: Bus definition, declaring a group of nets as one bus.

constraints.description: Electrical/geometric constraints: voltage/current limits, impedance and so on.

note.description: Free text; canonical JSON has no comments, this is the substitute.

id.description: page_instance_id; shares the board-level namespace with board-root refdes.

file.description: Relative path of the page source file.

id.description: Stable flattened instance ID: board-root U1, in-page M2.U1. Renaming changes identity; see ADR-0008 decision 3.

component.description: Component id (component_id), pointing to one component in the component library.

page.description: page_instance_id of an in-page instance; omitted for board-root instances.

params.description: Ordered as declared in the component's params section; optional columns may be omitted.

dnp.description: Whether it is not placed (unmounted but occupies a spot).

logical_only.description: E.g. power flags: exist only at the logical layer and produce no physical entity.

line.description: Starting line of the instance in the source file, for diagnostic locations.

note.description: Free text; canonical JSON has no comments, this is the substitute.

name.description: Parameter name, matching the column name declared in the component's params section.

value.description: The unit is determined by the type declared in the component's params section (resistance→µΩ etc.; see ADR-0008 decision 4).

name.description: Parameter name, matching the column name declared in the component's params section.

text.description: Non-numeric value of a parameter, e.g. a part description.

id.description: The flattened net name is the identity key.

members.description: Pin reference in numbered form (U1.1), not the pin name. A single-member net is legal but draws an ERC warning.

note.description: Free text; canonical JSON has no comments, this is the substitute.

id.description: Port name, the name visible outside the board.

net.description: Net name the port connects to (net_id).

page.description: Page port; omitted = board-level port. A port creates no node; it only gives an external name to an existing net.

id.description: Bus name, unique within the board.

type.description: As of v0.4 this is only a naming convention; no protocol validation is performed.

nets.description: List of net names the bus contains.

net_or_pin_ref.description: The subject can be a net (flattened name) or a pin reference; the two share the same shape and the parser resolves ambiguity by context.

subject.description: Constraint subject: net name or pin reference.
Constraint subject: net name or pin reference.
Constraint subject: net name or pin reference.

net_a.description: Net name of the positive side of the differential pair.

net_b.description: Net name of the negative side of the differential pair.

tolerance_ppm.description: Allowed tolerance of the differential impedance, ppm.

type.description: Constraint type: length difference between two nets.

net_a.description: Net name of the first net compared.

net_b.description: Net name of the second net compared.

op.description: Comparison operator applied to the length difference of the two nets.
